title: UX Page Read v1
description: One render of one public URL in a fresh anonymous browser context: rung R3 of the public-page reader. Written by a render driver (drivers/web/read_page.mjs) or assembled from a capture in the researcher's own private window, and consumed by `ux_research.py ingest`, which accepts it only after an anonymous read of the same URL that did not stop. The render never types, clicks or presses keys; it only scrolls, keeps the browser's own identity and uses no stealth. A check of any kind, one that would clear by itself included, is reported and never solved or waited out: ingest refuses a capture with challenge markers or a waited_ms above 0, and records it as a stop for the whole site. A login form is reported, never used.

status.description: HTTP status of the main document; 0 when unknown

title.description: page title; empty when a check stops the render before content collection

lang.description: document language; empty when a check stops the render before content collection

text.description: document.body.innerText after scrolling; at most 400 KB. Empty when any browser or human check stops the render.

json_ld.description: JSON-LD blocks as parsed values or raw strings; at most 10 blocks and 1 MB in total. Empty when a check stops the render before content collection.

robots.description: content of the robots meta tag

tdm_reservation.description: content of the tdm-reservation meta tag or header

interactive.description: an interactive human check (a widget, a press-and-hold, a picture puzzle) was on the page

login_form.description: a password field was on the inspected page; false when a check stops the render before this inspection

context.description: a fresh context with no stored cookies or sign-in

waited_ms.description: time spent waiting for a check to clear. The bundled driver never waits and always writes 0; values above 0 from other captures remain refused by ingest.

browser_connected.description: Chromium was connected through REMORSEARCH_BROWSER_WS rather than launched by the driver

playwright_client_version.description: Playwright package version loaded by the driver
